name: Kooni Curry (Shrimp Curry)
instructions: 1. Sauté whole spices and chilies. 2. Add shrimp and cook briefly. 3. Pour in thick coconut milk and simmer gently. 4. Do not boil vigorously to prevent curdling.
description: Tiny shrimp simmered in a velvet coconut sea, flavored with island aromatics.
